newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila raises weekly T-bill offer to 4.5 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila raises weekly T-bill offer to 4.5 bln pesos.

text.p: The Bureau of Treasury said on Friday it will raise the volume of its weekly auction of Treasury bills by one billion pesos to 4.5 billion pesos.
"This is in line with our programme. It is based on our cashflows," an official said.
Starting on Monday, the government will increase the weekly sales of 182-day and 364-day bills by 500 million pesos each to 1.5 billion and two billion pesos respectively.
The amount of 91-day bills to be offered will remain at one billion pesos. ($1 = 26.3 pesos)
